---
title: "_13_3_parallel_check"
format: html
---

```{r}

library(survey)
library(srvyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# オブジェクトクリア
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))

# DHSデータのルートフォルダを指定
gdrive_dir <- "/Users/snakada/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-snakada@g.ecc.u-tokyo.ac.jp/マイドライブ/Peru_work/Peru_endes/spss"

# 結果保存先
save_path <- file.path(gdrive_dir, "output")

# ステップ1: svydesignオブジェクトの読み込み
my_design <- readRDS(file.path(save_path, "svy_design_org.rds"))

# ステップ2: srvyrオブジェクトに変換
svy_obj <- my_design %>%
  as_survey_design()

# ステップ3: グループ別・年次別の加重平均を計算
plot_data <- svy_obj %>%
  mutate(
    nt_ch_stunt_num = case_when(
      nt_ch_stunt == "Yes" ~ 1,
      nt_ch_stunt == "No" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(year <= 2008) %>%
  group_by(treated_status, year) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_stunted = survey_mean(nt_ch_stunt_num, na.rm = TRUE, vartype = "ci"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 結果は通常のデータフレーム（tibble）として返される
# 列：treated_status, year, mean_stunted, mean_stunted_low, mean_stunted_upp
head(plot_data)

# ステップ4: ggplotで可視化
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = year, y = mean_stunted, 
                      color = treated_status, 
                      group = treated_status)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_stunted_low, ymax = mean_stunted_upp, 
                  fill = treated_status),
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +  # 信頼区間を半透明で表示
  labs(
    title = "stunting rate by treatment status over years",
    x = "year",
    y = "stunting rate (%)",
    color = "treated status",
    fill = "treated status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

```
